meta.title: ServoMold | Die & mold making and CNC machining, Istanbul
meta.description: Cutting dies, bending dies, plastic injection molds and die-casting molds; contract CNC turning and milling. Since 2010, Dudullu OSB, Istanbul, Türkiye.

hero.baslik: Die & mold making and contract CNC machining
hero.giris: We build cutting dies, bending dies, plastic injection molds and die-casting molds from your drawings. The machines that make our molds also machine your parts.
hero.gorselAlt: Milling a mold surface on a CNC machine

anasayfa.hizmetBaslik: Four mold families, contract machining and production lines
anasayfa.hizmetGiris: From sheet metal parts to plastic and cast parts: we design and machine the tool that will produce your part in series.
anasayfa.ilkeBaslik: Four principles we have kept since day one

termin.metin: The delivery date is where our plan starts; we build the job around it.

fiyat.metin: We build the tool your part actually needs, and price it accordingly.

kadro.metin: Your mold is prepared by our specialist team, from design to machining.

kalite.metin: Honesty and quality in service are what keep production successful and sustainable.

1.metin: We start from the part drawing or a sample, the material, volume and press details.

2.metin: Layout, tool steel and stations are designed around the part.

3.metin: Mold components are machined on CNC lathes and mills.

4.metin: The tool is assembled, first parts are measured and corrected if needed.

5.metin: The tool is delivered after your approval.

anasayfa.cncBaslik: Send us the drawing, get the finished part
anasayfa.cncGiris: From a single spare part to series parts, contract machining on CNC and conventional machines.
anasayfa.grupBaslik: The line that feeds your die comes from our group too
anasayfa.grupGiris: Servosteel designs and builds press feeding systems and coil processing lines. Planning the die and the line together settles die–press–feed compatibility from the start.
anasayfa.markaUst: Brands we use in our projects
anasayfa.ctaBaslik: Send your drawing and we will prepare a quotation.
anasayfa.ctaGiris: A drawing, a photo of a sample or a 3D model: whatever you have is enough. We will ask for anything missing.

hizmetSayfa.giris: Cutting dies, bending dies, plastic injection molds and die-casting molds; contract CNC machining and production lines from our group company Servosteel.

hakkimizda.giris: ServoMold was founded in 2010. Since then it has been producing cutting dies, bending dies, plastic and die-casting molds, and contract machining projects.
hakkimizda.metin1: Our principles have not changed: good service, on-time delivery and fair pricing. With our experienced team we design your tool, machine it in our workshop in Dudullu OSB and deliver it.
hakkimizda.metin2: We believe honesty and quality in service are what keep production successful and sustainable.
hakkimizda.misyon: To work as a team and offer the highest-quality products to export markets, keeping pace with the technologies shaping the Turkish machine building and assembly industry.
hakkimizda.grupBaslik: Part of the same group as Servosteel
hakkimizda.grupMetin: Our sister company Servosteel builds press feeding systems and coil processing lines. We plan the tool and the line within the same group.
